claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gated_ongoing_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Bane applies a persistent roll_modifier (-1d4) only to targets who FAIL an initial CHA saving throw. The ongoing_effect family applies its operation to all attachment targets unconditionally. The activation family supports save_gate phases but its Effect type (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) has no variant for 'apply an ongoing roll modifier for spell duration'. Neither family can express the combination of cast-time save filtering + persistent operation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save.

discrepancies: no content/bane.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
